Senses.Explanation: A fixed block naming the paired obstruction that keeps beings from what they already carry. Dahui Zonggao reads the pair as the one thing missing from a scene where all beings attain together with him, Tianru Weize tells the assembly they sit in the very field still uncrowned because the pair is not yet cleared, Zhongfeng Mingben likens the pair to the dust and grime on an old mirror's held light, Yinyuan Longqi rules the sage's sentence talk cut in two and holds that at his own midnight pole there is no mark to attain nor any pair to get, and Lüyan He sweeps every aid into the block: reciting and vows, the precepts and the watchers, the six ways and cause and effect, down to the fivefold week itself. Gusu Zun binds the marks and the pair into one ball with his staff and dares the assembly to name either, Yuan'an Liao reverses the sentence so that every buddha stands by the pair in having marks to attain and none could be crowned without it, Fushi Tongxian asks the assembly what the wisdom-and-virtue marks are once the pair is stripped away, Chulin Shangrui demands of the yellow-faced sage what he calls the marks and what the pair, and Neishao Zhizhong hangs the question on the hall: marks, or the pair?
